_comment: The root of the checkout, for the layers smart-base mounts (index.lock.json); smart-base's own layer is smart-base/, with its own package.json. Added 2026-11-13: without it, `site-publish.yml` failed on every push since it was added (2026-11-11) with "Cannot find package '@litlfred/cat-harness-tools' imported from fhir-harness/scripts/stage-local-ig.ts": the mounted layers import each other by package name, nothing publishes those packages, and the shared mount-layers action installs a root only when it declares workspaces. Same shape as smart-trust's root package.json.
name: @litlfred/smart-base-site
_scripts_comment: `cat` is the root bootstrap cat-harness-tools' instantiate-harness writes into every downstream root (templates/root-bootstrap/): `bun run cat <script>` mounts the layers from index.lock.json when they are missing or the lock moved (.github/mount-from-lock.sh), then hands over to cat-harness-tools/scripts/run-script.ts. Added 2026-11-13: without it `bun run cat ...`, which AGENTS.md and the platform's skills tell an agent to run, failed in this checkout with "cat: No such file or directory".
_workspaces_comment: The mounted code layers that carry a package.json, as workspaces; bootstrap declares no dependencies, so it is not listed. smart-base/ is not a workspace: its scripts reach zod and @litlfred/bootstrap-tools through the ONE root node_modules that bunfig.toml's hoisted linker lays out.
_overrides_comment: As smart-trust's: expo is reached only through fhir-harness's fhirclient -> isomorphic-webcrypto -> optional expo-random, and expo's latest asks for an @expo/cli npm does not have, so an install with no lockfile fails to resolve without the pin; the others keep the versions the sibling sites resolve.
